proof: THE DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE, pages 44-46 of the FY2016 annual town report: 39 bond issues against fiscal years 2017 to 2047, printed as PRINCIPAL / INTEREST / TOTAL per issue per year, with GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL, GRAND TOTAL INTEREST and TOTAL DEBT rows at the foot of each page. THE EXTENT: page 44 carries FY2017-FY2028, page 45 FY2029-FY2039, page 46 FY2040-FY2047 plus a TOTAL column. PAGE 46 ALSO REPRINTS FY2030, FY2031 AND FY2032, which page 45 already carries -- the figures are identical and they are transcribed as `line` rows, NOT summed, so no year is counted twice. The 31-year span is 2017-2047 with no gap. WHAT CLOSES, AND IT IS THE WHOLE PAGE. 228 per-issue-per-year identities assert principal + interest = that issue's TOTAL. Independently, the 228 issue-years sum across all three pages to the TOTAL column page 46 prints: principal $52,186,684 against a printed $52,186,686, interest $23,849,141 against $23,849,136, and the two together $76,035,825 against a printed TOTAL DEBT of $76,035,822 -- the last stated here rather than asserted, because THREE issue-years print principal and interest and no TOTAL cell, so the per-year total column cannot sum to it and a check on it would be a check on what the page omits. A DECLARED TOLERANCE OF $6, AND THE REASON. This schedule prints WHOLE DOLLARS over amounts that carry cents, so a printed total is the rounded sum and not the sum of the rounded parts. The evidence that it is rounding and not a misread is the DISTRIBUTION, not the size: of 228 per-issue identities every single break is exactly plus or minus one dollar and there is no break of any other magnitude anywhere on the three pages; the largest residual in the whole read is $1726370 on $76,035,822. A misread digit in figures of this size costs $10 or more far more often than $1, and could not produce breaks that are all +/-1 with both signs. The tolerance is NOT set to the residual: it is $6 against a worst case of $1726370. ONE DOCUMENT DEFECT, NOT RECONCILED. On page 46 the TOTAL column for `MASS WATER POOL 9*` is printed $3,171,339 while the same column prints principal $3,043,839 and interest $546,204, which sum to $3,590,043 -- out by $418,704, and $418,704 is exactly that issue's FY2024 principal, the last year it pays. So the printed issue total appears to omit one year. It is recorded as a `line` and is NOT part of any sum above; which figure the town intended is NOT established.
